commands.trivia: Ask a trivia question. First right answer in chat wins.
commands.coinflip: Flip a coin, or challenge a member to a flip with a stake.
commands.higherlower: Guess if the next number is higher or lower. Stake something if you like.

wrongChannel: Games run in other channels here.
economyOff: Stakes need Economy, and it is off here.
unknownMember: That's not a member I can find.

trivia.title: Trivia
trivia.none: No questions yet. An admin can add some in the dashboard.
trivia.running: A question is already open here.
trivia.prompt: Answer in chat. Time runs out {until}.

counting.broke: {reset, select, yes {{user} broke the count at **{reached}**. Next number is **1**.} other {{user}, that's not it.}}
counting.twice: {reset, select, yes {{user} counted twice in a row. Back to **1**.} other {{user}, wait for someone else.}}

wordchain.reset: {ended, select, yes {Chain ends at **{reached}**. Start fresh with any word.} other {Start fresh with any word.}}

hilo.running: You already have a game running in {channel}.
hilo.start: {staked, select, yes {The number is **{n}** (1 to {max}). {stake} on the line.} other {The number is **{n}** (1 to {max}).}}
hilo.how: Reply `higher` or `lower`, `stop` to cash out. Ends {until}.
hilo.right: {valued, select, yes {**{n}**. Right, {streak} in a row. Worth {worth} now.} other {**{n}**. Right, {streak} in a row.}}
hilo.wrong: {staked, select, yes {**{n}**. Wrong. {lost} gone after {streak, plural, one {# right guess} other {# right guesses}}.} other {**{n}**. Wrong. Streak ends at {streak, number}.}}
hilo.cashed: Cashed out {amount} after {streak, plural, one {# right guess} other {# right guesses}}.
hilo.refunded: Stopped before the first guess. {amount} back.

coinflip.busy: One of you already has an open coinflip.
coinflip.challenge: {staked, select, yes {{to}, {from} wants to flip a coin with you for {stake} each.} other {{to}, {from} wants to flip a coin with you.}}
coinflip.confirm: React with {yes} to accept or {no} to decline. Open until {until}.
coinflip.failed: Someone can't cover the stake anymore, so nothing happened.
